title: Haze: Healing Booster vs Bullet Lifesteal at the 16k slot (does heal amp apply to lifesteal?)
question: Does Healing Booster's +20% heal amp multiply Smoke T3 lifesteal and item bullet lifesteal, and is it worth more than Bullet Lifesteal in the same slot?
hypothesis: Model (haze_model.py): Bullet Lifesteal +204 HP per 1k souls vs Healing Booster +133 (amp applies) or +30 (amp does not apply) in a 12 s focus fight. Prediction: healing with Bullet Lifesteal >= healing with Healing Booster in both smoke and no-smoke blocks.
controls: hardreset between blocks (fresh pawns, factory cooldowns/charges, unlock 7 = all 3 tiers on every ability in BOTH arms)
Same position (fetch 350, aimoff 5.5 3), same enemy bot (Haze), egod default floor
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B (counterbalanced A,B,B,A for the second half)
healreset + mark none around every reset
cast reload 2.5 before each fire block (no auto-reload op)
two blocks per arm: (a) no smoke fire 4 s, (b) cast 2 0.3 then fire 4 s
procedure: per arm: give; lowhp 40; cast reload 2.5; mark <arm>_nosmoke; fire 4; healsum; healreset
cast reload 2.5; cast 2 0.3; mark <arm>_smoke; fire 4; healsum; lowhp 0

metrics.name: heal_per_damage_smoke
metrics.how: healDiffObserved / damage dealt (damage csv) in smoke block

decision.rule: Amp-on-lifesteal = (HB smoke ratio - base ratio) / base ratio ~= 0.20 confirms amp applies. SUPPORTS the reorder (Bullet Lifesteal at 16k) if bullet_lifesteal heal >= healing_booster heal; REFUTES if healing_booster heals >=10% more with non-overlapping ranges.

limitations: Checkpoint level/ability-tier states cannot be reproduced (unlock sets all tiers; GAPS #2): results are late-game relative comparisons only.
Regen part of Healing Booster (+3/s) is included in healDiffObserved; subtract 3 x 4 s x 1.2.
